name: westwood_online_upgrade_api_event_sink_on_pending_session_request_removed
description: WestwoodOnlineUpgradeApiEventSink::OnPendingSessionRequestRemoved handles the async WOL callback by formatting/removing accepted pending-session rows from the upgrade dialog.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/HLIL for 0x43f9d0 validates the stdcall three-argument callback shape, negative-status early return, zLoc::FormatMessage id 0x3004 into a 128-byte stack buffer using sessionRequest->m_sessionName, AppendStatusTextFmt of the formatted text, CWnd::SendDlgItemMessageA on control id 1137 with LB_FINDSTRINGEXACT and start index -1, the LB_ERR no-delete path, LB_DELETESTRING for found rows, and decrement of g_WestwoodOnlineUpgradePendingSessionResultCount only after deletion.

Native smoke westwood_online_upgrade_api_event_sink_on_pending_session_removed_smoke patches zLoc::FormatMessage, WestwoodOnlineUpgradeDialog::AppendStatusTextFmt, and MFC42 CWnd::SendDlgItemMessageA, and verifies negative-status no-op behavior, formatted status append arguments, find-miss count preservation, find-hit deletion arguments, and pending-session-result count decrement.
